run_create_roxford_dataset: run the script to create a VISSL-compatible Oxford dataset from input and output paths
download_oxford_dataset: download the Oxford dataset images and metadata archive to a specified root directory
create_revisited_oxford_paris_dataset: create a revisited Oxford/Paris dataset in VISSL classification format from input to output path
get_argument_parser: get an argument parser with input, output, and download flags for the roxford dataset script
cleanup_unused_files: cleanup unused archive files from the output directory after dataset conversion
